metadata.scope: Poore & Nemecek 2018 cradle-to-retail lifecycle emissions including land-use change and supply-chain losses (GWP100), as published by Our World in Data. Statistic: production-weighted MEANS dataset-wide (owner decision D1, 2026-07-18); the archived MEDIAN-without-losses set is the approved fallback with mandatory disclosure. Weights are as-purchased raw/dry; liquids at density 1.0 so per litre = per kg (error < 1.5%). Excluded: retail-to-home transport, home cooking and refrigeration energy, household food waste. Global category means, no organic/local modifier. This boundary differs from the transport calculator's operational-only scope -- values from the two calculators must NOT be summed.
metadata.primary_source: Poore & Nemecek 2018 (Science 360:987-992) via Our World in Data, means with supply-chain losses
metadata.basis: kg CO2e per kg of food as-purchased (raw/dry weight); serving presets are raw/dry grams; liquids per litre = per kg at density 1.0
metadata.citation_note: CSV-row citations (OWID grapher downloads) and Poore & Nemecek accepted-manuscript figure rows are verbatim data-row transcriptions (manuscript rows with single spaces), not page sentences. CarbonCloud citations are 'product | value | value-as-of date' transcriptions: CarbonCloud live values drift over time and are corroboration-with-access-date only (QA-6).

items.calculation_notes: P&N mean with supply-chain losses, cradle-to-retail incl. land-use change. Per-kg grapher literal 99.48; eight-stage supply-chain sum at full precision 99.4774 confirms (the two-decimal addends total 99.47, so always sum at full precision). The famous 60 kg/kg is the same study's MEDIAN without losses, not a rounding of this mean; the methodology sheet explains the difference.
